name: Photo Mode
description: Freezes the action and hands the camera to the player: free orbit, framing controls, filters, capture. It exists because a collectathon's payoff is a world worth looking at, and a player who just earned the vista wants the screenshot. This component owns the mode toggle, the detached camera while active, and the capture itself; on entry it takes over from presentation.camera_follow and hands control back on exit, so there is always exactly one camera authority. Filters are referenced as presentation.color_palette presets rather than implemented here, and hiding the HUD is a request the HUD honors, not a panel this component reaches into. It does not own where captures go — gallery and export are a persistence and platform concern — and it does not pause game logic; whether the world freezes is a time-scale decision made by the game mode, which keeps photo mode safe to offer in games where the world should keep breathing.

inputs.name: maxCameraDistance
inputs.description: How far the free camera may roam from the player. Bounded so photo mode cannot be used as a scouting wallhack in games where that matters.

inputs.name: fovRange
inputs.description: Adjustable field-of-view bounds. Wide bounds enable dramatic compression shots; narrow bounds keep every capture recognizably in-world.

inputs.name: filterPresetIds
inputs.description: Color-palette preset ids offered as filters. Empty means captures are unfiltered, not that filters are broken.

inputs.name: hideUI
inputs.description: Request HUD suppression while active. A request, not a takeover — the HUD decides how it hides.

outputs.name: capturedCount
outputs.description: Captures taken this session, for stats and for photo-challenge quests that count shots.
